hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const o=JSON.parse(d);const c=o.tool_input?.command||'';if(/\b(git\s+push|gh\s+pr\s+create)\b/.test(c)){process.stdout.write('GATE')}else{process.stdout.write('SKIP')}})"); [ "$CMD" = 'SKIP' ] && exit 0; node scripts/preflight.mjs --skip-clean-check || { echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Preflight gate failed. Fix all errors before pushing or creating a PR."}'; exit 2; }
